name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively releasing frequent patch updates across multiple stable branches simultaneously. The latest stable release is v0.62.5 (released July 16, 2025), with concurrent maintenance releases for v0.61.8, v0.60.13, v0.59.17, and v0.58.20 on the same date. A beta release of v0.63.0 was published on July 8, 2025 — not recommended for production. Both Open Source (v0.x) and Enterprise (v1.x) editions are available as Docker images and JAR downloads. Detailed per-release changelogs are linked via 'Full Changelog' on each release page at https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases.

answers.What is the current license?: Open Source edition uses AGPL v3; Enterprise edition uses a commercial license.
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases across several stable branches within days of each other, with ~80 release pages total.
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase offers a managed cloud (Metabase Cloud) at https://www.metabase.com.
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported as Enterprise/Pro features.
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, Oracle, Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, Druid, MongoDB, Presto/Trino, Spark SQL, Databricks, Athena, and more via drivers.

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Tableau offers best-in-class visualization and enterprise features, but is significantly more expensive and not open source compared to Metabase.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Lightdash integrates tightly with dbt for a metrics-as-code workflow, offering better data governance than Metabase but requiring dbt adoption as a prerequisite.
